title: USB 2.0 data pair (DP, DM) of a TI AM57xx or DRA7xx processor

spraar7j.title: High-Speed Interface Layout Guidelines, application note

impedance.where: Table A-2 (AM57xx/DRA7xx), row 'USB2.0 DP or DM pair differential impedance', page 16

length.where: Table A-2, row 'USB2.0 Tracelength (Total)', 12000 mil maximum, page 16

skew.where: Table A-2, row 'Skew within any USB2.0 differential pair', 50 mil maximum, page 16

vias.where: Table A-2, row 'Number of vias allowed on each USB2.0 differential trace (Total)', 4 maximum, page 16

single_ended.where: Table A-2, row 'USB2.0 DP or DM pair single-ended impedance', page 16
single_ended.not_judged: the single-ended impedance, 40.5 to 49.5 ohm, is not judged: the note does not say which impedance of a track in a coupled pair it means, and the command does not guess (the odd mode, Z_diff / 2, would repeat the differential row; a lone track's Z0 would not)

stubs.where: Table A-2, row 'Number of stubs allowed on any differential pair trace (Total)', 0 maximum, page 16; sections 3.5 (page 10) and 3.6 (page 11) name a through pin and a via's barrel past the signal's layer as stubs
stubs.not_judged: the stubs, 0 allowed, are not judged: the command does not trace a branch, a test point, or the barrel of a via or a through pin past the layer the signal leaves on

plane.where: section 2.4 'High-Speed Signal Reference Planes', page 6: over a solid reference plane, not across a split or a void
